abstract: Covers RFC 9457 Problem Details for HTTP APIs, which obsoletes RFC 7807: the application/problem+json object, its five members, extension members, defining problem types and the IANA HTTP Problem Types registry, plus the WWW-Authenticate challenge that pairs with 401 and 403 under RFC 9110, RFC 6750 and RFC 9470. It lists two version lines: RFC 9457 (current) and RFC 7807 (legacy, upgraded from). SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions and upgrades, the members and registry, authentication challenges, producer and consumer examples, and security considerations.
